changeRecord.title: releases that create a mechanism
changeRecord.target: node B1.1: all rotations released at every member end (CB1.1.j, BXA1.1.j, BYB1.1.i)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: Releases belong to member ends, the rotation belongs to the node. If every member end at a node is released, nothing holds the node's rotation: the stiffness matrix is singular. The structure may still look sensible (each member is pinned), but there is no solution; the correct answer is the diagnosis of the mechanism, and the fix is to keep one member end connected.
changeRecord.precondition: a node with frame member ends whose rotations are still connected and whose own rotations are not all held by a support
